name: Socorro (Colombia)
description: Light blue upper half, the middle divided vertically red and yellow, and a dark green stripe along the bottom.
history: Municipal flag of Socorro, a municipality in the department of Santander, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: light blue upper half, red-and-yellow middle band, dark green base
